title: The Great Pyramid When It Was Brand New
description: It wasn't always sandy brown. What Khufu's pyramid looked like around 2560 BCE, and what a real 4,500-year-old logbook tells us.

scenes.narration: The Great Pyramid wasn't always this rough brown colour. When it was new, it gleamed.
scenes.image_prompt: the Great Pyramid of Giza brand new, covered in smooth polished white limestone casing reflecting bright sunlight, clear blue sky, ancient Egypt

scenes.narration: It's around 2560 BCE, and you're standing at Giza as workers finish the tomb of the pharaoh Khufu.
scenes.image_prompt: thousands of ancient Egyptian workers on the Giza plateau near a nearly finished pyramid, ramps, ropes, sledges, dust in golden light

scenes.narration: Roughly two million stone blocks went into it. Many weigh more than two tonnes.
scenes.image_prompt: teams of ancient Egyptian workers pulling a huge limestone block on a wooden sledge with ropes, a man pouring water in front of the sledge on the sand

scenes.narration: The outer casing is fine white limestone, shipped across the Nile from the Tura quarries.
scenes.image_prompt: wooden boats on the Nile river carrying large white limestone blocks, ancient Egyptian sailors, pyramid visible in the distance

scenes.narration: We know this partly because an inspector named Merer kept a logbook of those boat trips. It's the oldest inscribed papyrus ever found.
scenes.image_prompt: ancient Egyptian official writing on a papyrus scroll with a reed pen, sitting on a boat on the Nile, hieratic script visible, warm evening light

scenes.narration: The finished pyramid stood about 146 metres tall, the tallest human-made structure on Earth for nearly four thousand years.
scenes.image_prompt: low angle view looking up the steep smooth white face of the Great Pyramid towering into the sky, tiny people at its base for scale

scenes.narration: Over the centuries, most of that white casing was stripped away and reused in other buildings.
scenes.image_prompt: medieval workers prying white casing stones off the side of a great pyramid, piles of stones below, carts, hazy desert light

scenes.narration: What you see today is the core. Which wonder should I rebuild next? Drop it below.
scenes.image_prompt: the Great Pyramid of Giza today with its rough stepped core blocks exposed, desert sand, golden hour, camels in the foreground
